async_search_info.message: Async examples search the public DummyJSON sample-user API. Try Emily or Michael, or an unmatched term for the empty state. defaultOptions preloads results; cacheOptions reuses successful searches. Use the Async search structure with autocomplete off and searchbar on to search inside the menu.

external_search_info.message: The wrapper owns a 250ms debounce, a three-character minimum, request cancellation, options, and loading. onInputChange reports input/clear; onSelect receives the complete option. Inspect the generated code for the integration.

rich_results_info.message: renderOption customizes results; the existing Trigger customDisplay renders selected company details. The selected option shown below retains custom company data.

quickpick_scope.message: Quick pick uses preset date-range options. Use customQuickPickDates to replace or extend them, and pair controlsStartId / controlsEndId with DatePicker when you need synced date inputs.

multi_options.message: Multi-select returns arrays of selected options. Use formPillProps to adjust the selected-pill appearance and clearable to let users reset the selection.

autocomplete_info.message: Autocomplete filters the provided options list in place. It works especially well with longer option sets.

quickpick_custom_info.message: When override is omitted or true, customQuickPickDates replaces the default quick-pick menu.

quickpick_append_info.message: Set customQuickPickDates.override to false to append your custom ranges to the built-in quick-pick options.

constrained_height_info.message: constrainHeight restricts the height of the dropdown menu and enables vertical scrolling when the content exceeds this height. This prevents long dropdown lists from rendering off-screen.

disabled_options_info.message: Set disabled: true on individual option objects to keep them visible while preventing selection.

subcomponent_structure_info.message: Switch Structure to “With Subcomponents” to see the explicit Dropdown.Trigger, Dropdown.Container, and Dropdown.Option composition API.

loadOptions.description: Promise or callback loader. Receives the search term; return options with id, label, and value plus any custom data.

searchbar.description: Show a search input inside Dropdown.Container. Turn autocomplete off to try this mode.

options.description: Dropdown option data with label, value, id, and optional disabled state.
